Subject: Sudden throughput drop and 5xx spike (generate) - urgent

Hi Priyom,

Since ~09:00 UTC we've been seeing a sustained throughput drop on /v1/generate and a concurrent rise in 5xx responses. This is impacting our nightly reporting pipeline and blocking a critical customer-facing batch job. Samples and traces attached (octant_incident_samples.tar.gz, initial_logs.txt).

Questions:
- Is there a known outage or rolling maintenance on your side?
- Can you confirm whether any autoscaling or routing changes were applied in the last 24h?

—Olivia
Head of Platform, Octant Analytics

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-10T10:05:00Z
Subject: Internal: initial triage notes (Octant incident)

Internal notes from the 09:50 triage call:
- Symptom: throughput drop + increased 5xxs on generate endpoints correlated with elevated queue depth on the serving runtime.
- Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: a kernel-selection fallback scenario combined with a new batching profile caused backpressure on a subset of GPU workers; certain long-context requests blocked CPU threads that manage batching windows.
- Immediate mitigations executed:
  * Reduced max_batch_tokens from 4096 -> 1024 on the affected pool (deployed 10:15)
  * Enabled kv-cache pre-warm on warmup workers (10:22)
  * Routed traffic to model-variant v1.2-fallback for heavy-context tenants (10:25)
- Result: error rate reduced by ~65% in the canary, throughput recovering but still below baseline for high-concurrency workloads.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: follow up with runtime team to prepare kernel-selector patch (INF-3344)
- Grace: coordinate exec notice and draft RCA for Octant
- Priyom: confirm schedule for full RCA + remediation timeline

Attachment: mitigations-runbook.md (internal)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@octant.ai>, Matthew Locke <matthew.locke@octant.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-11T16:40:00Z
Subject: Octant: RCA and remediation plan (deliverable)

Olivia / Matthew,

Please find the attached RCA packet and remediation timeline (OCTANT_RCA_Jan10.pdf, remediation_timeline.xlsx). Executive summary:
- Root cause: rare kernel-selection path that produced inefficient kernels for >64k-context sequences combined with a new batching profile; this produced worker-level backpressure and amplified latencies under high concurrency.
- Short-term mitigations: reduced batch cap, KV-cache warmup, traffic reroute to fallback variant (already deployed).
- Medium-term fixes (trackable): kernel-selector patch, safer batching defaults, enhanced runtime health checks by 2027-01-14.
- Ownership: see spreadsheet for owner assignments and milestone dates. Primary owner for customer remediation is Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai).

We propose an executive readout tomorrow at 10:00 UTC to walk you through the RCA and confirm remediation milestones. Please confirm availability.

Attachments: OCTANT_RCA_Jan10.pdf, remediation_timeline.xlsx

Best,
Priyom

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-12T14:30:00Z
Subject: Exec summary: Octant incident, business impact and proposed mitigations

Folks — brief exec-level summary for review before the readout:
- Impact: Octant saw ~6h of elevated errors and a 35% dip in peak TPS during a busy window; estimated revenue risk tied to renewal (deal OCT-2026-42) and potential SLA credit exposure.
- Technical root cause: kernel-selector edge case + aggressive batching defaults on a heterogenous pool.
- Immediate next steps we committed:
  * Kernel-selector patch (INF-3344) targeted 2027-01-14
  * Safer batching defaults rolled to 80% of baseline for all mixed-tenant pools (in flight)
  * Enhanced alerting for queue depth and model-variant fallbacks
  * Proposal: expedited reserved capacity for Octant (commercial to discuss offsetting credit exposure)

I've opened INF-3344 in Jira: https://jira.redwoodinfra.com/browse/INF-3344
Cost estimate for Octant credit exposure attached in the readout doc.

—Vivek
Head of Sales
